evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/forms/FormsScreen.tsx:121 — `{forms.length} form{forms.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} available` hardcodes English binary (1 vs many) pluralization via string concatenation. This is a CORRECTNESS bug distinct from the already-tracked translation-gap findings (code-review-mobile-rn-screen-header-titles-i18n flags this subtitle as a missing-t() literal, but a naive `t('forms.countAvailable', { count })` fix that still interpolates `count + ' form' + (n===1?'':'s')` would remain wrong). The app ships 6 locales (frontend/apps/mobile/src/locales/: sk, cs, pl, de, hu, en). Slavic locales sk/cs/pl have 3-4 CLDR plural categories (one/few/many/other), and the binary `=== 1 ? '' : 's'` renders grammatically wrong counts in 5 of the 6 shipped languages (e.g. sk needs distinct forms for 1 / 2-4 / 5+). Correct fix: i18next ICU/count plural keys (`t('forms.available', { count })` with one/few/many/other sub-keys in each locale json), never a JS ternary appending 's'.
